texts.source_text: Learn a Skill and Work with a Will - Part 1
texts.content_exam: We make thousands of decisions a day. Making a choice is easy. Choosing well takes knowledge and skill. You have many decision-making examples in daily life such as deciding what to wear, what to eat for lunch, what task to do next, choosing which book to read, etc. Decision making is an ongoing process in every aspect of life, large or small. The ability to make a decision and stick to it is the cornerstone of good leadership skills. Having critical thinking skills allows one to ascertain the problem and come up with a suitable and beneficial solution. Before taking a step, we must try to see where possible potholes are. This won't just make us stronger moving forward. It will also give us more determination and awareness about what we are deciding.

questions.question: We make ______ of decisions a day.
Making a choice is ______, but choosing well takes knowledge and skill.
The ability to make a decision and stick to it is the ______ of good leadership skills.
What allows one to ascertain the problem and come up with a suitable solution?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: Critical thinking skills (Having critical thinking skills allows one to ascertain the problem...).

questions.question: What must we try to see before taking a step?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: Where possible potholes are (Before taking a step, we must try to see where possible potholes are).

texts.source_text: Learn a Skill and Work with a Will - Part 2
texts.content_exam: The decision-making tools help you to map out all the possible alternatives to your decision, its chances of success or failure. So to make a decision, you must first identify the problem you need to solve or the question you need to answer. What also prevents effective decision-making is when you do not have enough information about your decision. In this case you are making a decision without any basis. Teamwork helps you to make the right decision. You must collaborate with your family members and classmates, at some point, to make your right decision. Time management is very important; since decisions need to be made quickly sometimes, you have to outline the amount of time you have to make your decision. Also, organization is vital in your making a final decision. You should use this skill to find out what results you're looking for and if it's a top priority.

questions.question: Teamwork helps you to make the right decision.
Time management is not important when making decisions.
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: False (Time management is very important).

questions.question: Organization is vital in making a final decision.
Who should you collaborate with to make the right decision?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: your family members and classmates

questions.question: What do decision-making tools help you do?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: map out all the possible alternatives

texts.content_exam: Sam walked into a cake shop, after he'd finished his work, to buy his daughter a birthday cake. It was about four o'clock and the store usually closes at five. So he should make his mind quickly and decide what he should buy. Sam asked himself "Which one should I choose?" He began wandering in the shop watching the various kinds of cakes which were kept in the refrigerators around. The cakes looked very delicious and tasty so it was difficult for Sam to choose. Time was passing but in vain. Sam couldn't decide yet, when he heard the chef saying "Come on. Hurry up, please, we are about to close the store." "No, wait please, I should choose the most suitable and delicious cake." Sam said sorrowfully.

questions.question: Sam walked into a cake shop to buy ______ .
options: a birthday cake for his daughter
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: a birthday cake for his daughter

questions.question: The store usually closes at ______ .
The cakes looked very ______ .
The chef asked Sam to ______ .
Sam walked out of the shop ______ .

texts.content_exam: It was difficult for Sam to choose, when he heard the chef saying "Come on. Hurry up, please, we are about to close the store." "No, wait please, I should choose the most suitable and delicious cake." Sam said sorrowfully. Sam's eyes kept moving from one refrigerator to another, but all of the options looked so good and he couldn't make a decision yet. "Try to be quick Man, make up your mind, we have to close," the impatient chef said. Suddenly, the chef had enough and asked Sam to leave immediately. Sam walked out of the shop empty-handed feeling depressed and frustrated. He wanted them all, but ended up with nothing because he couldn't choose any. Think of what happened to Sam. It's just that we're all Sam and the world is that cake shop.

questions.question: Sam walked out of the shop with a big cake.
We have extremely large numbers of options available to us.
The real danger is making the wrong decision.
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: False (The real danger is making no decision at all).

questions.question: Why did Sam end up with nothing?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: because he couldn't choose any

questions.question: What is the real danger according to the text?
questions.explanation: ✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: making no decision at all and ending up going nowhere and doing nothing.
